_doc: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 GPU (Adreno-750-like) spec for SoC profile sd8gen3_cim (ADR-0008). EVERY number is BORROWED from HeteroInfer (SOSP'25, arXiv 2501.14794v2; cim-mobile-soc/docs/heteroinfer-design-reference.md): the `anchors` are Table 3 latencies of the paper's own W4A16 OpenCL kernels (weight [N_out,K_in], activation [K_in,M]); `anchor_fit` is our 2-regime roofline reproduction of them (tools/analysis/fit_hetero_anchors.py; model = simulator/models/m4_gpu_anchor.py). NO silicon of ours; NOT a calibration.
honesty: borrowed (HeteroInfer published Table 3/Fig.1 numbers; fitted, no silicon of ours)

notes.shape_semantics: paper: weight [N_out, K_in] x activation [K_in, M]; simulator Workload (M, K=K_in, N=N_out).
notes.weights: W4A16: 0.5 B/weight when computing streamed bytes (weight_bytes_per_param in anchor_fit).
notes.decode_regime: a constant-BW roofline cannot beat ~15% on the three M=1 anchors (implied effective BW 16/20/31 GB/s rises with N_out); the floor absorbs the per-kernel dequant/launch cost of the paper's GEMV kernel.
notes.kernel_launch_us: ASSUMPTION for attention/elementwise kernels: §4.3 'tens of microseconds' GPU submission overhead. The fitted gemm_floor (~320 us) is a GEMV-kernel cost, NOT a launch floor.
notes.attention: no attention anchor in the paper (checklist item 9) -> attention/elementwise pricing is EXTRAPOLATED from the GEMM fit.

provenance.anchor_fit: minimax relative-error fit of the anchors (fit_hetero_anchors.py) [borrowed, fitted]

anchor_fit._doc: 2-regime KERNEL-TIME minimax fit of `anchors` under pred = max(kernel, 0.5*K*N/43 GB/s) (fit_hetero_anchors.py, ADR-0008 rev F2/F3). GEMV: gemv_floor + K*(N+n_half)/rate; GEMM: gemm_floor + 2MKN/(C_max*M/(M+M_half)); M>1 = min(M*GEMV, GEMM); gemv_floor <= 60 us (§4.3 launch band). [borrowed, fitted]
